in_sanskrit.name: तुलराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the form of Rama, who is full of Tula (balance, stability)

in_hindi.long_meaning: तुल (तुला, tula) - राम (राम, rama) का रूप वाला (one who has the form of Rama)

in_tamil.name: துலராம
